Email 2 — Option F · Red Signal (dark)

More sales ≠ more profit

Your biggest sales month shouldn’t mean giving away half the sale.

If you’re paying 30%, 40% or even 50% commission, sales growth and profit growth can be two different things.

Hypothetical $100 order
30%
commission
$30 paid out.
40%
commission
$40 paid out.
50%
commission
$50 paid out.

Commission only. Remaining revenue is not net profit.

Affiliates can earn their place. They don’t have to be your only route to the next order.

Build another way to acquire customers.

TOMA brings paid campaign strategy and creative together for peptide businesses. Less dependence on organic reach and expensive influencer deals. Another channel to test against your actual acquisition costs.

Creative built for a restricted category.

Native-style ads, video and animated creative, developed around Meta’s rules and the requirements relevant to your eligible offer—not hidden claims or a generic ecommerce template.

Know what growth leaves behind.

Paid advertising isn’t free or automatically cheaper. Track acquisition cost, ROAS and ROI with the relevant costs included. Invest where the economics support it, rather than chasing a bigger revenue number alone.
